What we do

Every move.
Tracked.

Indian e-commerce moves fast. Prices change by the hour on Amazon. A competitor goes OOS on Blinkit and your rank shifts overnight. Traditional BI tools can't keep up with that cadence.

Nextract was built to close that gap. We continuously crawl product listings, catalogue pages, pricing, stock signals, seller data, and rankings — then deliver it as clean, structured data through whichever surface your team already uses: a spreadsheet, a REST API call, or a live dashboard.

How it works

Building with honesty.

Crawl layer

Managed proxy rotation and anti-blocking infrastructure handles marketplace rate limits, CAPTCHAs, and anti-bot defences — so you never have to.

Data layer

Raw page data is normalised, deduplicated, and structured into consistent schemas — same field names, same formats, across every marketplace.

Delivery layer

Your data reaches you via Excel exports, REST API, or a live dashboard — pick the surface that fits your workflow.
